triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fixlens_private.record_case_submission()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.case_updates (case_id, update_type, message, created_by, created_at)
  values (new.id, 'submitted', 'Maintenance report submitted.', new.renter_id, new.created_at);
  return new;
end;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER record_visitor_case_submission AFTER INSERT ON public.cases FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.demo_session_id IS NOT NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION fixlens_private.record_case_submission()
